builds.name: Siphon Power: discharge AD/AP crossover
builds.summary: Investigate high Siphon Power empowered discharge attack output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high Siphon Power empowered discharge attack output under fixed, reproducible conditions; compare one-slot swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 discharge helper is 120 + 0.5 AP + total AD magic damage. The earlier missile is a separate 120 + 0.4 AP packet. High AD can compete with AP for the discharge alone, while AP becomes more valuable when scoring the complete missile-plus-attack sequence. Lich Bane is a separate Spellblade event, not a multiplier on the entire helper.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability maximum learned rank unless explicitly overridden, minute 30. Enemy champion: 3000 maximum HP, 100 armor and 50 MR. Separate missile setup from the discharge-only result; no E/R, shield or another ordinary attack added. Loaded owner HP 100%, target HP 100%, observation 3s. Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected. Prior champion combat 0s does not automatically grant arbitrary item stacks.

kitEvidence.formula:
Viktor blasts an enemy, dealing [60 / 75 / 90 / 105 / 120 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage and granting Viktor [characterLevelInterpolation(40 → 140; raw flags preserved) + (0.25) × AP] Shield for [2.5] seconds.

Viktor's next Attack within 4 seconds deals [20 / 45 / 70 / 95 / 120 + (0.5) × AP + (1) × AD] magic damage.

Upgraded: Grants [(characterLevelInterpolation(40 → 140; raw flags preserved) + (0.25) × AP) × (1.6)] Shield and Viktor additionally gains [30]% Move Speed for [2.5] seconds.
